title: AIR-LLM: Broadcasting AI Weights over Radio for Memory-Free Edge LLM Inference via RF Computing
abstract: arXiv:2610.00465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Next-generation large language models (LLMs) are expanding from the cloud to ubiquitous edge devices. However, edge devices typically either lack the memory to store increasingly large LLM weights or, even with enough memory, spend unaffordable energy on loading the weights. This raises our question: can an edge device run an LLM without storing or loading its weights, but receive them over the air and consume them on the fly? Inspired by wireless broadcasting, we present AIR-LLM, an LLM inference architecture for edge devices, which is composed of: (i) a central radio (e.g., 5G base stations) that broadcasts the LLM weights into the air, and (ii) the edge user that receives the weights and completes the general matrix-vector multiplication (GEMV) of LLM inference directly in the radio frequency (RF) domain using RF mixers. translated_title: AIR-LLM：通过射频计算在无线电上广播AI权重，实现无内存边缘LLM推理
translated_abstract: 下一代大语言模型（LLM）正在从云端扩展到无处不在的边缘设备。然而，边缘设备通常要么缺乏存储日益庞大的LLM权重所需的内存，要么即使有足够的内存，加载权重也会消耗难以承受的能量。这引出了我们的问题：边缘设备能否在不存储或不加载权重的情况下运行LLM，而是通过空中接收权重并即时消耗它们？受无线广播的启发，我们提出了AIR-LLM，一种面向边缘设备的LLM推理架构，由两部分组成：（i）中央电台（例如5G基站），将LLM权重广播到空中；（ii）边缘用户，接收权重并使用射频（RF）混频器直接在射频频域完成LLM推理中的通用矩阵向量乘法（GEMV）。为进一步缩短空中传输时间，AIR-LLM利用MIMO空间复用，并提出了一种节能的预（注：摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AIR-LLM架构，由中央电台（如5G基站）在空中广播LLM权重，边缘设备利用射频混频器直接在射频频域完成矩阵向量乘法，从而实现无需存储或加载权重的边缘LLM推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AIR-LLM, an architecture where a central radio (e.g., 5G base stations) broadcasts LLM weights over the air, and edge devices use RF mixers to perform general matrix-vector multiplication directly in the RF domain, enabling memory-free edge LLM inference without storing or loading weights.
